speaker: Old Kings' Cairn
description: An Old Kings' cairn at the old root (plan M6-M9 §5.4, decision 33; P35): reading it once gives one attribute point (once-flag reward.cairn.old_root).

nodes.text: A cairn in the hollow under the fallen titan-tree, older than the tree that fell on it. Cut into its capstone: 'We slept under the roots of the world when the world was young.'

choices.text: [Lay a hand on the stones] (+1 attribute point)

nodes.text: An Old Kings' cairn. Its strength is already in you.
